name: Kyoo
description: Kyoo is a self-hosted media server for movies, series and anime, an alternative to Jellyfin or Plex. It identifies files without a required folder structure, pulls metadata from TheMovieDB and TheTVDB, and transcodes on the fly with hardware acceleration.

notes.text: There is no default account: the first account registered becomes the administrator, so create it right after the install.
Kyoo uses HTTPS with a self-signed certificate, so accept the browser warning. Until the first video is scanned, the home page only shows "Resource not found.".
Behind a reverse proxy or under another address, set PUBLIC_URL and JWT_ISSUER in /opt/kyoo_data/.env to the same new URL, then run systemctl restart kyoo-auth kyoo-api kyoo-scanner.
